_about: Painted build icons still to make with the Canva image generator, in order (tab by tab). An icon is done when tools/ai_cameos/<file>.png exists; never regenerate a done icon. Canva gives about 3 images a day; an hourly job makes the next ones as soon as the credits reset and reports only when a whole tab is finished (or a bug is found).
style: Video game build-menu unit icon, real-time strategy game like Command & Conquer: {subject}, isometric three-quarter view from above, highly detailed semi-realistic 3D render, dramatic studio lighting, dark navy blue gradient background, centered, full body, no text
